methodology.projectedTeamTouchdownsBaseline: 55% weighted team offensive TD/game plus 45% opponent defensive TD allowed/game, with a small non-neutral home/away adjustment.
methodology.paceIndex: Team offensive plays/game blended with opponent defensive plays/game and indexed to league average 100.
methodology.defensiveVulnerability: Percentile rank of weighted TDs allowed per game to the player position; scorer-position rates are coverage-normalized and higher is more vulnerable.
methodology.warning: These are matchup context scores, not touchdown probabilities. Live weather and confirmed Week 1 roles remain gated.
